meaning:
vomit, what is vomited up
Another spelling of qi (קִיא "vomit" H6892B)

elsewhere.note: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his…
“Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.
